name: com.pugsoda/pugsoda
title: PugSoda
description: Browse trending TikTok AI meme video templates, prices, photo tips, and direct upload links.

tools.name: list_trending_memes
tools.description: List trending TikTok AI meme video templates on PugSoda, ordered by heat and recency, with subject requirements (1 person, 2 people, couple, or pet), clip length, starting one-time price, free preview availability, and direct upload URL.

subject.description: Optional filter by who goes into the video: person (1 person), pair (2 people), couple, or pet.

limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return (1–50, default 15).

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search all PugSoda AI video templates, TikTok meme swaps, themed family photo studios, and product video templates by keyword, theme, or subject.

query.description: Keyword to match against template title, H1, teaser, description, or tags (e.g. "cat", "car", "dance", "saloon", "christmas").

limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return (1–50, default 20).

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get full details for a PugSoda template by slug: what photo to upload, clip duration, pricing, whether a free first-frame preview is shown before payment, step-by-step instructions, FAQ, and the direct upload URL.
